**Claude review** of the whole pull request, at `0be08de`: all 8 files reviewed.

2 finding(s), 0 to fix; 2 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

I found no correctness or security bugs in the locking and atomic-write changes. I left two notes. `remove()` still deletes the old `.tmp` name, which new temp files no longer use, so crash leftovers pile up. The chmod-based test fails when run as root.
